reason: I'd actually start the 14-day trial since there's no auto-charge, which I like after getting burned once. But when it asks me to pay, I'll probably go back to free YouTube sleep music, because a few minutes' difference won't feel worth 4,900 won a month to me.
objection: YouTube sleep music is free and already works well enough. I'm not convinced a fade-out timer and a resume button are worth paying for, and I doubt my phone can really tell when I fell asleep.
would_change_my_mind: If the day-14 comparison clearly showed I fell asleep at least 10 minutes faster on the SLEEP:ON nights, I might pay for one month to see if it holds up.
